content.jointProblem: Can Serbian morphological reduction combined with script-aware token canonicalization and query expansion reduce LinguaBot's useful-result miss rate from 18% toward its below-5% target while supporting vocabulary updates without full re-indexing? The first experiment would compare the current Elasticsearch pipeline with normalization and morphology ablations on held-out support queries, explicitly testing transfer to banking terminology, short queries and within-word script mixing, while measuring retrieval quality, latency and update effort.

rationale.text: His research directly examines how Serbian morphological reduction interacts with script normalization, providing a grounded starting point for testing pipeline order.

sources.quote: U ovom radu ispitujemo kako stemovanje i lematizacija interaguju s postupkom normalizacije skripte pri izgradnji pretražnog indeksa.

rationale.text: He has evaluated phoneme-based canonicalization for Serbian retrieval against script-specific baselines, addressing the company's cross-script mismatch problem.

sources.quote: The phoneme-based canonical form reduced the out-of-vocabulary rate from 9.3% to 2.1% compared with a Latin-only baseline

rationale.text: His transliteration research offers a candidate strategy for exceptional tokens rather than relying solely on deterministic normalization.

sources.quote: The paper concludes that a cascaded system — deterministic rules followed by the neural model for detected exceptions — outperforms either component alone

rationale.text: His work includes incremental mixed-script indexing, relevant to investigating vocabulary and content updates, although it does not establish update compatibility with LinguaBot's existing index.

sources.quote: Kada tok vesti dolazi iz više izvora koji koriste različita pisma, inkrementalni indekser mora da normalizuje pismo svake pristigle stavke pre umetanja.

rationale.text: He has experience integrating script normalization into company search systems as an add-on rather than replacing the entire system.

sources.quote: Administrativni troškovi uvođenja bili su niski jer je modul integrisan kao dodatak bez izmene ostatka sistema.

constraints.text: The solution must address Serbian inflection and mixed scripts, including within-word mixing; cross-script normalization alone would leave part of the stated failure mechanism unresolved.

sources.quote: Our current Elasticsearch setup uses a basic stemmer that was built for Croatian and misses a significant share of Serbian-specific forms.
our users freely switch between Latin and Cyrillic script mid-sentence — sometimes mid-word in typos.

constraints.text: Integration must accommodate the existing Elasticsearch retrieval system and vocabulary updates without a full re-index; ongoing manual synonym-list maintenance is not an acceptable primary solution.

sources.quote: Our current Elasticsearch setup uses a basic stemmer
can be updated when new vocabulary arrives without a full re-index.
maintaining those lists manually does not scale as clients add new product terminology every quarter.

constraints.text: Evaluation must use the company's labelled support data and linguist validation, with an agreed definition of a useful result. The below-5% miss rate is a target to test, not an established outcome.

sources.quote: We have a labelled query-response dataset of around 85,000 pairs across all clients, and our two in-house linguists can annotate or validate proposed solutions.
A good outcome is getting that 18% miss rate below 5% and keeping it there with a manageable maintenance process.

constraints.text: A testable prototype must fit the six-month window and approximately EUR 8,000 tooling/data-work budget; research fees, engineering effort and infrastructure coverage require clarification.

sources.quote: Budget for tooling or data work is modest — around 8,000 EUR — and we want something testable within six months.

constraints.text: Scope the collaboration as a small research-led engagement: the researcher reports capacity for one smaller industrial contract or consultancy, not unrestricted software development.

sources.quote: Trenutno je angažovan na dva aktivna projekta, ali ima kapaciteta za jedan manji industrijski ugovor ili konsultantski angažman.
nije zainteresovan za opšte projekte razvoja softvera bez istraživačke komponente.

risks: Results on legal, news and benchmark collections do not validate performance on banking/telecom support queries or within-word script typos. The first experiment must test these transfer gaps separately.
More than half of the observed misses were attributed to morphology or script confusion, not all misses. Resolving these mechanisms alone may be insufficient to reach the below-5% target.

The researcher's company pilots still required terminology updates. Automatic adaptation without manual list maintenance or full re-indexing remains unvalidated, and changed canonical forms may be incompatible with existing indexed tokens.

Foreign loanwords, abbreviations, alphanumeric strings and proper nouns are documented normalization challenges; aggressive normalization or stemming could conflate distinct product terms and reduce precision.

Researcher start date and weekly availability remain unknown despite stated capacity for a small engagement. Company engineering allocation, production hardware, latency limits and full project funding are also unknown.
Permission to access and process bank/telecom query data, privacy controls and permitted external-service use are unknown and could delay evaluation or restrict implementation.
questions: Can the researcher commit to the six-month window, and what start date, weekly effort and deliverables fit his existing commitments?
Does the EUR 8,000 cover only tooling and data work, or also research fees, infrastructure and engineering? Which company engineers and linguists will be allocated?
Can a de-identified query set, historical knowledge-base snapshots and relevance labels be accessed under client-approved terms? What restrictions apply to external APIs and model training?
How was 'no useful result' defined in the 12,000-query bank sample, and should the below-5% target apply to that bank, each client or pooled traffic?
Which Elasticsearch version, analyzers, index mappings and custom spaCy components are deployed? Does 'without a full re-index' also prohibit an initial migration or a small auxiliary index?
What latency, throughput, memory and infrastructure limits must the prototype meet, and what production-like environment is available for testing?

Can the first experiment reserve client- and time-separated test data, including new product terms, within-word mixed-script typos and exceptional tokens, with linguists judging both recovered answers and false matches?
What level of ongoing annotation or exception review counts as manageable maintenance, and who will own vocabulary updates and regression testing after the project?
